description: Equip a core instance (core_id = the INSTANCE id from forge_inventory, not the catalogue key) on one of your roster entities (beast_id), or unequip with core_id null/omitted. A core has a single bearer: equipping it elsewhere moves it. The relic slot is independent. Free; applies to your next Fosse or ladder fight. Errors: invalid_beast (not your entity), core_not_found (not a core instance of your inventory).

beast_id.description: Id of one of your roster entities.

core_id.description: Instance id of a core you own (forge_inventory → equipment[].id). null or omitted → unequip.
